chunks: 3173 - And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has entrusted with al-Ḥusayn, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, seventy thousand angels who send blessings upon him every day, disheveled and dust-covered, and they supplicate for those who visit him, and they say: O Lord, these are the visitors of al-Ḥusayn; do for them, and do for them."

key_terms.زُوَّارُ الْحُسَيْنِ: the visitors of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ: seventy thousand angels assigned to him

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the angels assigned to Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and those who visit him?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the special heavenly honor granted to al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, with seventy thousand angels continuously sending blessings upon him. It also highlights the merit of visiting him, as the angels supplicate to Allah for his visitors.
